A squat air mover sits on the tile aimed at the opened wall; a manila claim folder rests on the dryer. Warm worklight rakes from the left, cool window glow from the right; bone white, deep pine green and ochre with graphite shadows. rationale: The story turns on the one claim that counts — the appliance water loss — at the decisive moment it is opened, dried and filed; a cinematic still holds that moment with physical atmosphere rather than a generic laundry room. The cut wall makes the hidden loss visible and the claim folder carries the paper that decides renewal, exactly the article's mechanism.

core_thesis: A homeowners policy is repriced on counted claims, not dollars paid — and the appliance water claim is the one that counts, with a written warning after the second gating the third at renewal.
core_conflict: Weather losses that cannot be counted versus nonweather water losses that climb the three-in-three count; the dollars paid matter less than the paper trail — the warning letter and the passed inspection — that decides whether the policy survives.
